title: Pulsar APX PRO Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Introducing the Pulsar APX PRO Vaporizer

The Pulsar APX Pro Vape Dry Herb Vaporizer is crafted to make every vapor session straightforward while giving the user complete control. Users can take temp control into their own hands with this handy vape!

The APX Pro Vape has a slim design with an ergonomic mouthpiece to maximize comfort, and temperature can be adjusted to a desired setting anywhere between 320 and 430 degrees Fahrenheit in 1 degree increments using the two temp adjustment buttons. The OLED display screen will show the desired temp as well as the current temp of the vape, and the haptic feedback will alert the user once the appropriate temperature is reached. The vape also features a Cash Mode: simply hold down the power button to increase heat in the chamber and get the most out of your material.

The session timer on the APX Pro Vape can be adjusted to turn off heat automatically after a set amount of time using pre-set timers of 3 to 5 minutes. Use the onboard stir stick to mix up herb in the aluminum heating chamber and ensure evenly toasted hits through the power of hybrid convection/conduction heating.

The display screen also shows the battery life. Charge up by plugging the vape into any 5V wall adapter with the included USB-C charge cord and the Pulsar APX Pro Vaporizer will be ready for action!

Pulsar APX Pro Features:
Compatible with Dry Herb
4.3″ Tall Slim Design
2100mAh Battery Capacity
Full Temp Control (320°-430°F)
Haptic Feedback & OLED Display
Session Timer & Cash Mode
Isolated Ceramic Airpath
Hybrid Convection/Conduction Heating
Includes Onboard Stir Stick
1 Year End User Warranty
Multiple Colours and Designs Available

What’s in the Box:
1x – Pulsar APX Pro Vape Dry Herb Vaporizer
1x – Onboard Stir Stick
1x – Cleaning Brush
1x – USB-C Charge Cord
